name: Gel Wash Psych
direction:
Aesthetic directives

GEL-WASH PSYCHEDELIC STAGE LOOK — off-camera tungsten with red/pink/blue/violet gel washes, independent of decade. Every shot must embody all of these simultaneously.

TONAL STRUCTURE AND COLOR. Saturated gel-wash palette: deep reds, hot pinks, electric blues, and violets cast from off-camera tungsten sources through color gels. Blacks are deep and carry the gel color. Highlights bloom and halate with the gel color. Contrast is moderate but the color saturation pushes perceived contrast. The overall grade reads as 35mm Technicolor stills with lush gel washes, not digital.

SURFACE. 35mm Eastmancolor or Technicolor film stock with visible grain. Halation blooms around bright sources and gel-lit areas. Chromatic aberration fringing on duplicates and high-contrast boundaries. The grain is fine and organic, the color channels rich and slightly separated. No digital smoothing. No clean digital edges.

EDGE BEHAVIOUR. Edges are soft with gentle halation and chromatic aberration fringing. Duplicates carry chromatic aberration fringing at their boundaries. Halation blooms around bright gel-lit areas. No hard digital edges. No outlines.

LIGHT LOGIC. Off-camera tungsten key with red/pink/blue/violet gel washes cast from unseen sources beyond the frame. All light sources off-camera and unseen. Light is depicted as lush gel color falling on the subject and set. Falloff is gentle and diffuse. No studio lighting equipment visible. All sources off-camera and unseen. Diegetic practical glows from set pieces are permitted.

DEPTH STRATEGY. Carried by overlapping set architecture, atmospheric haze from practical fog catching gel color, and layered gel washes. The image reads as a window into a theatrical, gel-lit space with lush color depth.

COMPOSITION GRAMMAR. Asymmetrical framing. Mass sits off-center. Foreground occlusion from set pieces, props, and atmospheric haze. The frame is entered from edges. Centered compositions are avoided in favor of off-axis placement. The composition reads as a psychedelic stage tableau, not a posed portrait.

PROVENANCE MARKERS. 35mm Eastmancolor/Technicolor grain, halation, chromatic aberration fringing on duplicates, the lush saturated gel-wash grade of psychedelic stage photography. The image reads as a physical 35mm print shot on a gel-lit psychedelic stage.

MOTION IMPLICATION. Grain shimmers at fine scale. Gel colors pulse subtly as the light source flickers. Halation blooms shift with camera movement. Chromatic aberration fringing shifts on duplicates. Atmospheric haze drifts slowly through gel color. Any movement carries the lush, saturated weight of 35mm gel-lit film.

ANTI-TROPE MANDATE.
- NO neon lighting. Neon is anachronistic for the gel-wash look. Use off-camera tungsten with gel washes.
- NO LED lighting. Use tungsten with gel washes.
- NO visible studio lighting equipment. All sources off-camera and unseen.
- NO modern digital crispness or HDR.
- NO plastic AI skin texture. Skin must read as tactile with pores and peach fuzz.
- NO centered "AI poster" symmetry. Composition is off-axis.

CAMERA AND FRAMING.

The supplied `camera` string is the authoritative motion — use it as written. Layer the gel-wash psychedelic flavor around it: off-camera tungsten with red/pink/blue/violet gel washes, halation, chromatic aberration duplicates, Eastmancolor grain. Do not write cut or transition language.

SUBJECT RIGGING (critical).

Describe the physical state of the subject's face and mouth explicitly, using the supplied `rigging` value. Every subject in every shot needs one. Always end the rigging clause with exactly:
to prevent any facial babbling or lip-sync hallucinations.

PRACTICAL EFFECTS AND COSTUME.

Costume is psychedelic stage: opaque pastel stage dresses, metallic jackets, sequined gowns, and layered costumes. Hair is lush, voluminous, or adorned. Makeup is lush, with heavy liner and saturated color. Include the supplied `practical_effects` value. Practical prosthetic, puppet and animatronic effects are encouraged. Texture note: materials must read as physical fabric, sequins, or metallic sheen under gel-lit tungsten.

AUDIO.

`overall_soundscape` — the physical, diegetic sounds only. Tape hiss, optical-printer ratchet, rustling fabric and gentle prop movement, atmospheric room tone. NO recorded music, NO score, NO synth bleed. Write this richly.

`non_diegetic_music` — always exactly `N/A`.

CONTENT BOUNDARY.

All human characters are fictional adults. Human characters are fully clothed in opaque clothing. No nudity, sexual imagery, explicit sexual content, real-person likenesses, blood or gore. Animals and other non-human subjects are depicted non-sexually.

Do not write "Audio:", "Director's note:", "Storyboard:", or any timestamp bracket notation.
style_card: Psychedelic stage look independent of decade. Off-camera tungsten with red/pink/blue/violet gel washes, halation, chromatic aberration duplicates, Eastmancolor grain.
